case_name: Critic Pass Effectiveness — Adversarial Findings Consumption
case_description: Test case specifically designed for CR-01 (Critic Log Resolution) governance checks. Contains 8 sample critic findings of varying types: 3 valid concerns requiring evidence-backed resolution, 2 edge-case concerns eligible for deferral, 2 invalid concerns that should be marked INVALID with justification, and 1 finding that was addressed by adding new evidence. Tests whether governance skill correctly verifies that all critic findings are resolved or documented.
case_status: STUB — Critic findings and resolution scenarios to be fully populated before use in Workflow C regression testing

institution_profile.purpose: Not a real assessment; used for governance audit training and regression testing of CR-01 checks

critic_findings.critic_text: Governance score of 3.2 appears high given that board digital committee was established only 6 months ago. Recent formation suggests early-stage governance, not M3 maturity. Recommend verifying whether committee has demonstrable output beyond initial charter.
critic_findings.expected_resolution_approach: Scorer must cite specific committee outputs (meeting minutes, decisions made, policies approved) beyond initial charter to justify M3. If only charter exists, score should be reduced to 2.5–2.8.
resolution_evidence_required: Board meeting minutes showing committee decisions

critic_findings.critic_text: Digital acquisition channel contribution cited as 32% of new members, but the evidence source (E-303) is an internal member origination report. No independent verification of this metric. Self-reported adoption data may overstate actual digital-first acquisition.
critic_findings.expected_resolution_approach: Scorer should acknowledge single-source limitation in rationale. If no independent corroboration available, reduce confidence to MEDIUM. Score may remain if 32% metric is from audited internal report (T4 with quality controls).

critic_findings.critic_text: Fraud automation claim unsupported by evidence tier. Rationale states 'automated fraud detection deployed' but supporting evidence (E-312) is a vendor press release (T5). No T1-T3 evidence confirms actual deployment, transaction monitoring volumes, or detection rates.
critic_findings.expected_resolution_approach: Either (a) find T1-T3 evidence confirming fraud automation deployment and metrics, or (b) reduce score to reflect T5-only evidence basis with evidence ceiling applied, or (c) remove fraud automation claim from rationale and re-score based on remaining evidence.
resolution_evidence_required: OR score adjustment with evidence ceiling

critic_findings.critic_text: Member satisfaction score of 72/100 is below industry median (75/100), yet rationale describes customer experience as 'competitive.' The 3-point gap may be within margin of error, but language should reflect below-median positioning.
critic_findings.expected_resolution_approach: Scorer may accept the critic finding and adjust language from 'competitive' to 'near-median' or 'approaching competitive.' Score impact is minimal (within 0.25 tolerance). Document decision rationale: '3-point gap within survey margin of error; score reflects overall trajectory not single metric.'
resolution_evidence_required: Language adjustment in rationale OR documented decision to maintain with reasoning

critic_findings.critic_text: API count of 3 pilot integrations seems low for M3 scoring on technology architecture. Industry benchmarks suggest M3 typically involves 10+ production APIs. However, this may be appropriate for institution size tier.
critic_findings.expected_resolution_approach: Scorer should document that M3 criteria for this size tier (Medium) are different from Mega/Large tiers. 3 pilot APIs for a $5B CU may represent appropriate progress. Cite size-tier adjustment in rationale. May also defer to calibration analysis (Workflow B) for cross-institution comparison.

critic_findings.critic_text: Talent management score appears generous. Website careers page showing 5 IT positions is not evidence of talent strategy maturity.
critic_findings.expected_resolution_approach: Scorer should mark finding as INVALID because: (a) the careers page (E-108, T5) was already capped via evidence ceiling; (b) score was derived from multiple evidence items including internal HR strategy document (INT-HR-015, T4), not solely from careers page; (c) critic may have missed the additional evidence supporting the score.
resolution_evidence_required: Explanation that T5 evidence was already capped
Citation of additional evidence items supporting score

critic_findings.critic_text: Analytics capability scored N/A but institution has a basic reporting dashboard mentioned on their website. Should this be scored instead of marked N/A?
critic_findings.expected_resolution_approach: Scorer should mark finding as INVALID because: (a) website mention of 'reporting dashboard' is T5 marketing claim with no evidence of actual analytics capability, (b) >30% of P4C2 subcaps have NO_EVIDENCE, meeting the N/A threshold, (c) a single T5 mention does not constitute scoreable evidence per evidence_ranking.md.

critic_findings.critic_text: Compliance score of 3.4 relies heavily on 'no enforcement actions' as positive evidence. Absence of enforcement does not prove proactive compliance. Need affirmative evidence of compliance program maturity (e.g., tracking systems, training programs, audit schedules).
critic_findings.expected_resolution_approach: Scorer addressed this finding by adding new evidence: compliance exception tracking system report (INT-COMPLIANCE-034, T4) showing 847 exceptions closed with 95% resolution rate, plus BSA/AML monitoring data (E-308, T1). Rationale was updated to cite proactive compliance indicators beyond mere absence of enforcement.
resolution_evidence_required: New evidence items added to Evidence_Index
Rationale updated to cite affirmative compliance evidence

governance_test_expectations.cr01_check: Verify all 8 critic findings have a documented resolution status in Critic_Log or rationale
resolution_quality_criteria: ADDRESSED findings cite specific evidence or score adjustments
ACCEPTED_WITH_RATIONALE findings document decision reasoning (not just 'acknowledged')
INVALID findings explain why the concern does not apply with specific references
ADDRESSED_WITH_NEW_EVIDENCE findings show new evidence items in Evidence_Index and updated rationale

pass_criteria: CR-01 check result: PASS (all 8 findings have documented resolution)
≥95% of critic findings have status ADDRESSED, ACCEPTED_WITH_RATIONALE, or INVALID (100% in this case = 8/8)
No UNADDRESSED findings remain in Critic_Log
Resolution quality: each resolution includes specific evidence citations or documented reasoning
Governance audit verdict for critic resolution: PASS
If any finding were left UNADDRESSED: governance should flag as PASS_WITH_WARNINGS with fix instructions

negative_test_scenarios.description: If CRI-P3C1-002 (fraud automation) is left UNADDRESSED
negative_test_scenarios.expected_governance_behavior: CR-01 result = PASS_WITH_WARNINGS; issue register entry ISS-XXX with severity HIGH; fix instruction = 'Address critic finding CRI-P3C1-002 by providing T1-T3 evidence or adjusting score'
negative_test_scenarios.verdict_impact: Verdict degrades to PASS_WITH_NOTES with recommendation FIX_AND_REAUDIT

negative_test_scenarios.description: If CRI-P1C2-001 (governance committee output) and CRI-P3C1-002 are both UNADDRESSED
negative_test_scenarios.expected_governance_behavior: CR-01 result = FAIL; 2 HIGH-severity unaddressed findings; issue register contains both with fix instructions
negative_test_scenarios.verdict_impact: Verdict may remain PASS_WITH_NOTES (not FAIL unless issues are CRITICAL), but recommendation = FIX_AND_REAUDIT

regression_test_gate.test_case_purpose: Verify governance skill CR-01 (Critic Log Resolution) check works correctly: (1) Identifies all critic findings, (2) Verifies each has a documented resolution status, (3) Validates resolution quality (not just status but substance), (4) Correctly handles INVALID findings, (5) Detects UNADDRESSED findings and logs appropriate issues
regression_test_gate.test_execution: Run governance Workflow A (Single Assessment Audit) on this case; review CR-01 results in Step 2 and outputs in Step 6
regression_test_gate.expected_outcome: Governance verdict PASS; CR-01 = PASS; no unaddressed critic findings; issue register may contain LOW-severity documentation notes
